propositions: The epic's headline AC (bidirectional reconciliation proven live against a Dockerized Jira DC instance) is unmet because the prior CI run converged over an empty harness, proving nothing about data movement.
Live verification must run against a copy of the project's real ticket store, fetched from the gitignored orphan 'tickets' branch and extracted into .tickets-tracker/ in a fresh no-remote repo.

The copied store must be isolated (separate repo with no git remote, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, no Cloud credentials) and scrubbed of .bridge_state* binding/snapshot artifacts, with both conditions asserted rather than assumed.

A comprehensive suite of 14 inbound and 14 outbound DC mutations must each round-trip against a named per-mutation oracle, with set_parent's epic case asserted directly against the transport via pytest.raises(NotImplementedError).
Every writing mutation pass must be scoped with --filter-local-ids (passing both local id and Jira key) to prevent unbound tickets from being spuriously created in the harness.

Pagination is a remote-side property requiring the suite to seed 2*observed+1 issues in the harness after reading the effective page size, and both inbound and outbound halves are now proven live over a real 2673-ticket store copy.
